sub_question: Step 2: Identify the matches that were lost by the team the player was playing for
sub_sql:
WITH subquery AS (
  -- Previous Valid SQL Foundation
)
SELECT subquery.*, pm.team_id AS losing_team_id
FROM subquery
JOIN player_match pm ON subquery.match_id = pm.match_id AND subquery.player_id = pm.player_id
JOIN match m ON subquery.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE m.team_1 = pm.team_id AND m.match_winner = m.team_2
OR m.team_2 = pm.team_id AND m.match_winner = m.team_1
